interface.name: jwm_remote_control_manager_v1
interface.description: This private protocol is not a desktop portal. A trusted local host must obtain explicit control consent, select a source on this connection, and authenticate its remote peer. The explicit version-two create_lease_with_scroll request grants only discrete vertical wheel actions; version-three create_lease_with_scroll_axes grants only its explicitly named axes. It cannot switch focus or authorize drag, clipboard, or global input.

request.name: create_lease_with_scroll
request.description: Like create_lease, but additionally grants single-notch vertical wheel actions. Binding version two alone does not grant scroll. The original create_lease never grants scroll.

request.name: create_lease_with_scroll_axes
request.description: Explicitly permits only the named axes: bit 0 vertical, bit 1 horizontal. Values 1, 2 and 3 are valid; zero and unknown bits are denied. Old creation requests retain their original permissions at every bind version.

interface.name: jwm_remote_control_lease_v1
interface.description: A lease expires after 30 seconds and never revives. Each capture source permits exactly one bundle attempt, consuming both input channels including failed admission; a fresh explicit local source selection is required to attempt another lease. The host must compare the full viewer and native XKB maps, then arm using its first genuinely ready image-copy frame only after the authenticated viewer reports drawing it. The compositor cannot prove physical display. One sequence orders all keys and pointer actions. Any held key forbids pointer actions. Each pointer action requires a fresh ready frame after every prior input action. Keyboard input gates fixed surface geometry, not latest visual content per key.

arg.name: kind
arg.summary: 0 motion, 1 atomic left click, 2 wheel up, 3 wheel down, 4 wheel left, 5 wheel right; vertical requires explicit v2 or v3 grant, horizontal explicit v3 axis grant

arg.name: reason
arg.summary: 1 denied, 2 source, 3 focus or seat, 4 local takeover, 5 timeout, 6 malformed sequence, 7 quota
